verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a commerce and payments platform, but the evidence only touches the edges. Sellers get explicit catalog deletion semantics: replace-mode uploads permanently delete omitted products. Either party can terminate an OCA, which ends agent–seller data access, and customers choose which accounts Link CLI can read. Missing for 10: documented retention periods or policies, user-initiated deletion of personal and transaction data, controls over agent-accessed data after access is revoked, and independent corroboration.
